Stormbreak corridor width is increased by 1 block. Corridor hits apply Slowness I for 1.5 seconds.

effect.simplymastery.thunderhead.descrip: Stormbreak completes its full dash, then creates a thunderclap with 2 additional blocks of radius that pulls enemies inward.
effect.simplymastery.static_reserve.desc: While sprinting, your attacks have a 40% chance to refresh Stormbreak.
effect.simplymastery.charged_pursuit.des: Refreshing Stormbreak grants Speed III for 2 seconds and never shortens an active Charged Pursuit.
effect.simplymastery.crosswind.descripti: Corridor hits pull enemies toward Stormbreak's path instead of pushing them aside.
effect.simplymastery.capacitor.descripti: Each enemy hit by the corridor increases thunderclap damage by 8%, up to a maximum of 40%.
effect.simplymastery.flashguard.descript: Completing Stormbreak grants Resistance I for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.afterimage.descript: Stormbreak's path remains charged for 2 seconds, dealing 30% of corridor damage to each enemy that crosses it once.
effect.simplymastery.building_voltage.de: Consecutive attacks increase Stormbreak refresh chance by 5%, up to 20%. Stacks expire after 3 seconds and clear on refresh.
effect.simplymastery.live_wire.descripti: While Charged Pursuit is active, your attacks deal additional lightning damage. Can only occur once every 0.5 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.feedback_loop.descr: After a refresh, the next Stormbreak used within 5 seconds deals 20% increased damage.
Kills during Charged Pursuit extend it by 2 seconds, up to 6 seconds remaining.
effect.simplymastery.unbroken_pace.descr: Taking damage while sprinting grants Speed II and Resistance I for 1.5 seconds. Can only occur once every 6 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.perpetual_motion.de: A refresh grants Overdrive for 6 seconds. The next Stormbreak used during Overdrive has 30% reduced cooldown.
effect.simplymastery.flashover.descripti: A refresh chains lightning to up to 3 nearby enemies for 35% thunderclap damage.
effect.simplymastery.ionize.description: Stormbreak damage applies Ionized for 5 seconds, enabling further Skywrath effects.
effect.simplymastery.arc_lash.descriptio: Your attacks against Ionized enemies arc lightning to another nearby enemy. Can only occur once every second.
effect.simplymastery.pressure_drop.descr: Thunderclap applies Weakness I to Ionized enemies for 3 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.updraft.description: Thunderclap launches enemies 50% higher and applies Slow Falling for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.fulmination.descrip: Ionized enemies killed by Storm's Edge discharge lightning around themselves for 25% thunderclap damage.
effect.simplymastery.stormshield.descrip: A thunderclap that hits grants Absorption for 4 seconds, increased when it hits 4 or more enemies.
effect.simplymastery.reverberation.descr: Thunderclap repeats after 0.75 seconds for 30% damage and applies no additional knockback.
effect.simplymastery.judgment_bolt.descr: Thunderclap calls a second full-strength lightning strike onto its strongest surviving target.
effect.simplymastery.supercell.descripti: Thunderclap leaves a storm for 4 seconds that damages and pulls enemies inward once every second.
effect.simplymastery.sulfurous_edge.desc: Brimstone eruption chance is increased by 5%.
effect.simplymastery.scorching_brand.des: Eruptions burn for 5 seconds and deal 15% increased damage to enemies already burning.
effect.simplymastery.blast_furnace.descr: Eruption radius is increased by 1 block and eruptions deal 15% increased damage.
effect.simplymastery.kindling_blows.desc: Each attack that fails to erupt increases eruption chance by 5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Cleared on eruption.
effect.simplymastery.flashpoint.descript: At maximum Kindling, your next eruption is guaranteed.
effect.simplymastery.cinder_scatter.desc: Eruptions launch 3 cinders at nearby enemies for 20% eruption damage.
effect.simplymastery.backdraft.descripti: Eruptions pull enemies toward the primary target and apply Slowness I for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.chain_reaction.desc: Enemies killed by an eruption detonate once for 50% damage, up to 8 detonations.
effect.simplymastery.crucible_strike.des: Eruption radius is reduced to 60%, but the primary target takes double eruption damage.
effect.simplymastery.lengthened_chain.de: Brimstone Rite target jump range is increased by 4 blocks.
effect.simplymastery.furnace_bellows.des: Brimstone Rite pulses every 0.8 seconds instead of every second.
effect.simplymastery.stoked_furnace.desc: Brimstone Rite radius growth per pulse hit is increased, and its maximum radius is increased by 1 block.
effect.simplymastery.shackling_heat.desc: Brimstone Rite pulses pull enemies inward and apply Slowness I for 2 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.overpressure.descri: Each pulse that hits increases pulse and plunge damage by 10% for the cast, up to a maximum of 50%.
effect.simplymastery.snapback.descriptio: When Brimstone Rite jumps to a new target, it deals 35% pulse damage within 3 blocks.
effect.simplymastery.molten_wake.descrip: Brimstone Rite leaves fields for 2 seconds that deal 20% pulse damage once every second.
effect.simplymastery.executioners_drop.d: Brimstone Rite plunges after 3 seconds and deals 225% plunge damage.
effect.simplymastery.perpetual_furnace.d: Brimstone Rite lasts 10 seconds and its pulses build from 75% to 150% damage, but its plunge deals 50% damage.
effect.simplymastery.cinder_mantle.descr: Starting Brimstone Rite grants Absorption I for 4 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.tempered_flesh.desc: Brimstone Rite grants Fire Resistance through its duration and plunge.
effect.simplymastery.heat_sink.descripti: Taking damage during Brimstone Rite builds up to 2 stacks. Your next pulse that hits converts them into Absorption.
effect.simplymastery.furnace_reprisal.de: Enemies that hit you during Brimstone Rite are burned and take 20% pulse damage. Can only occur once every second.
effect.simplymastery.forged_resolve.desc: While below 40% health, a pulse that hits grants Resistance I and Absorption II. Can only occur once per cast.
effect.simplymastery.ashen_step.descript: Taking damage during Brimstone Rite grants Speed I for 3 seconds. Can only occur once every 5 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.bulwark_pulse.descr: A pulse that hits 3 or more enemies refreshes Absorption I for 3 seconds.
effect.simplymastery.walking_furnace.des: Brimstone Rite follows you with reduced radius, pulls enemies inward, and grants Resistance I.
effect.simplymastery.last_reprisal.descr: Falling below 35% health during Brimstone Rite triggers an empowered early plunge and grants Absorption II and Resistance II.
skill.simplymastery.watcher_claymore.sig: Dread duration is increased to 13 seconds.
Dread stacks up to 6 times on each Watched enemy.
You can Watch up to 7 enemies at once. The oldest is released first.
Your attacks deal 3% increased damage per Dread on the target, up to a maximum of 18%.
While an enemy has 4 Dread, your attacks apply 1 Dread for 8 seconds to the nearest unwatched enemy within 4 blocks. Can only occur once every 2 seconds.
Striking the same enemy within 1.5 seconds applies 2 Dread instead of 1. Can only occur once every 4 seconds against the same enemy.
Casting Final Omen at maximum Dread refunds 1.5 seconds of its cooldown once the Omen resolves.
Maximum Dread is reduced to 3, but you can Watch up to 12 enemies. Final Omen consumes your 3 nearest Watched enemies within 12 blocks and deals 70% damage. Cooldown is increased by 25%.
Only one enemy can be Watched at a time, but Dread stacks up to 8 and each stack increases Final Omen's damage by 20%. Watching a new enemy clears the previous one.
skill.simplymastery.watcher_claymore.com: Final Omen resolves in 2.7 seconds without losing any bat swoops.
Final Omen summons 1 additional bat per Dread consumed, up to a total of 17.
Final Omen bat swoops deal 12% increased damage.
Final Omen's Slowness IV lasts 4.5 seconds.
Each bat swoop that hits increases Final Omen's damage by 3%, up to a maximum of 36%.
Once per Final Omen, a target that moves beyond 12 blocks is pulled 2 blocks toward you.
Final Omen deals 15% increased damage and scales up to 90% with the target's missing health.
Final Omen lasts 5 seconds and sends 20 bat swoops that deal 65% damage, but its own damage is reduced by 35% and cooldown is increased by 3 seconds.
Final Omen sends no bats and resolves after 1 second for 190% damage, but applies no Slowness and scales only up to 35% with missing health.
skill.simplymastery.watcher_claymore.tra: At maximum Dread, Final Omen executes enemies below 28% health. Against Bosses, this cannot occur.
Absorption gained from executions is increased by 15%.
Final Omen grants 1 Absorption per 10% of the target's maximum health removed during the ability, up to 4, even if the target dies.
Kills from bat swoops or Final Omen still reset its cooldown, and now grant Resistance I for 3 seconds.
Melee damage you take from enemies with 4 or more Dread is reduced by 15%.
When you fall below 30% health, apply 2 Dread to the nearest Watched enemy within 12 blocks. Can only occur once every 10 seconds.
Absorption gained from Final Omen increases your next attack's damage by 5% per point, up to a maximum of 40%. Expires after 6 seconds.
Executions are disabled. Enemies below the threshold are instead left at 1 health and rooted for 3 seconds, and grant 150% Absorption, but kills no longer reset Final Omen's cooldown.
At maximum Dread, Final Omen executes enemies below 35% health but grants no Absorption. A failed execution deals 30% reduced damage and increases cooldown by 5 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.the_devourer.signatu: Devouring Mass radius is increased to 4.3 blocks, and it draws enemies from 8 blocks away.
Devouring Mass pulses deal 10% increased damage.
Devouring Mass pulls enemies inward 20% more strongly.
Devouring Mass lasts 45 seconds before collapsing.
Devouring Mass can hold up to 8 enemies at once.
Enemies held by Devouring Mass for 5 seconds are damaged 20% more often.
When Devouring Mass collapses, it deals 125% of its pulse damage to up to 12 enemies within 4.5 blocks.
Devouring Mass slowly follows the nearest enemy it has not captured within 10 blocks and lasts 30 seconds, but its radius is reduced to 3 blocks and its damage is reduced by 20%.
Devouring Mass no longer moves. Its radius is increased to 6 blocks, it holds up to 12 enemies, and it pulls 50% more strongly, but it damages every 1.5 seconds and cooldown is increased by 25%.
Devouring Mass collects up to 96 loose items and experience orbs, and pulls them in 16% faster.
Devouring Mass extends 5 retrieval tendrils at once instead of 3.
Up to 16 enemies spread Devouring Mass Gloam, and its trail widens to 1.6 blocks.
Devouring Mass Gloam lasts 4 seconds, and contact with it applies Slowness II.
Each enemy held by Devouring Mass increases its damage by 3%, up to a maximum of 24%.
Each kill inside Devouring Mass increases its duration by 1 second, up to 5 seconds per cast.
An enemy held by Devouring Mass for 8 seconds takes 75% of its pulse damage. Can only occur once per enemy per cast.
Devouring Mass collects up to 160 loose entities and pulls them twice as fast, but it holds only 3 enemies and its damage is reduced by 30%.
Devouring Mass ignores loose entities and spreads no Gloam, but deals 175% damage to enemies it holds. Each kill inside it reduces cooldown by 1 second, up to 8 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.the_devourer.transfo: Ravenous Reprisal applies Slowness I to your attacker for 2 seconds.
Ravenous Reprisal radius is increased to 4 blocks.
Ravenous Reprisal drags enemies inward 18% more strongly.
Enemies dragged into an active Devouring Mass take 25% increased damage on its next pulse.
Triggering Ravenous Reprisal grants you 3 Absorption for 3 seconds.
Ravenous Reprisal catches up to 8 nearby enemies, but they take 70% damage.
Ravenous Reprisal opens around you, deals 50% damage, pushes up to 8 enemies away instead of dragging them, and grants you Resistance I for 3 seconds. Can only occur once every 4 seconds.
Ravenous Reprisal strikes only your attacker for 225% damage and drags it to an active Devouring Mass up to 30 blocks away, but catches no other enemies. Can only occur once every 2 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.signatur: The returning Wickpiercer burns enemies it passes for 50% of throw damage.
Direct hits from Wickpiercer set the target on fire for 3 seconds.
Wickpiercer flies back to you far faster after a throw.
Wickpiercer passes through one enemy for 70% damage before returning.
A direct hit deals 35% of throw damage to up to 5 enemies within 2.5 blocks. Can only occur once per throw.
Wickpiercer is thrown far faster and direct hits deal 180% damage, but it loses Loyalty and only returns after 3 seconds.
Wickpiercer deals 60% damage on impact, then orbits its target for 3 seconds and strikes it every second for 45%. Cooldown is increased to 5 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.o: Frenzy lasts 5.5 seconds, or 11 seconds while dual wielding.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.r: Killing an enemy with a Frenzy attack does not consume the stack. Can only occur once every second.
Consuming Frenzy sets the target on fire for 2 seconds, and deals 20% increased damage to burning enemies.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.t: Each Frenzy attack within 2 seconds of the last deals 5% increased damage, up to a maximum of 20%.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.c: While dual wielding Wickpiercers, a throw grants 2 Frenzy, and Wildfire Frenzy consumes only 1 stack. Can only occur once every 2 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.f: Frenzy attacks deal 45% of their bonus damage to up to 6 enemies within 3 blocks, but consume 2 stacks and are never conserved on kill.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.combat.r: Frenzy stacks up to 3, but each Frenzy attack deals 175% bonus damage and ignores 4 Armor.
skill.simplymastery.wickpiercer.transfor: While you have at least 1 Frenzy, damage you take is reduced by 10%.
Resistance III from reviving lasts 7 seconds.
When you fall below 30% health, gain Resistance I for 3 seconds. Can only occur once every 15 seconds.
When you revive, up to 8 allies within 6 blocks gain Regeneration II for 4 seconds.
Your first attack within 5 seconds of reviving deals 60% bonus fire damage and burns for 5 seconds.
Revival cooldown is reduced by 15%, to a minimum of 30 seconds.
Reviving restores 50% health instead of full health and grants Resistance II for 4 seconds, but its cooldown is reduced by 40%.
A killing blow deals 200% of throw damage to up to 12 enemies within 5 blocks and leaves you at 1 health with no Resistance. Can only occur once every 60 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.gloampiercer.signatu: Shadow clone cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds.
Shadow clones throw their spear 0.35 seconds after appearing.
Shadow clone targeting cone is increased to 125 degrees and its range to 14 blocks.
Shadow clone spears deal 10% increased damage.
Every third activation summons 2 Shadow clones that strike separate enemies. The second deals 70% damage.
A swing with no target in range stores an additional Shadow clone for 4 seconds, released on your next valid swing.
Shadow clone spears turn 33% more sharply and stay in flight for up to 5 seconds.
Each activation summons 3 Shadow clones that strike up to 3 enemies for 55% damage, plus any clone stored by Patient Hunter, but Shadow clone cooldown is increased to 1.2 seconds.
A single Shadow clone, plus any clone stored by Patient Hunter, strikes the nearest enemy for 220% damage with sharper homing, but its targeting cone narrows to 70 degrees and its range to 10 blocks.
Phantom Phalanx begins throwing sooner and continues later into the channel.
Phantom Phalanx spears travel 10% faster and deal 8% increased damage.
Gloam spear explosion radius is increased to 3 blocks, hitting up to 8 additional enemies.
Every second spear strikes the ground across a 7 block radius instead of every third.
Phantom Phalanx channel is reduced to 2.6 seconds and its cooldown to 21 seconds.
Phantom Phalanx throws 30 ground-targeted spears across 10 blocks for 65% damage with no homing, but you cannot move during its 3.5 second channel.
Phantom Phalanx throws only 6 homing spears at a single enemy for 240% damage each, but their explosion radius is reduced to 1.5 blocks and cooldown is increased by 4.5 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.gloampiercer.transfo: Gloam radius is increased to 1.8 blocks where a spear lands.
Gloam duration is increased to 15 seconds.
Gloam Slowness begins at level II and lasts 3 seconds.
Enemies standing in your Gloam take 15% increased damage from Gloam spear explosions.
Embedded Gloam spears trigger within 1.5 blocks and last 7 seconds.
Triggering an embedded Gloam spear detonates the nearest other embedded spear within 5 blocks shortly after.
Gloam spear explosions pull up to 6 enemies standing in your Gloam 1 block inward before dealing damage.
Your Gloam seeks the nearest visible enemy within 6 blocks and lasts 10 seconds, but Gloam spear explosions deal 25% reduced damage.
Gloam no longer applies Slowness and lasts only 5 seconds, but when it expires it deals 80% of spear damage to up to 6 enemies within 2.5 blocks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.signature: Thrown Wraithfang deals 10% increased damage, including the strength it gathers in flight.
Wraithfang returns with Loyalty II once its hunt or anchor ends.
A thrown hit afflicts its target with Weakness I for 3 seconds.
Wraithfang sharpens faster over its first 2 seconds of flight, then gathers strength at its normal pace.
A thrown hit marks its quarry for 4 seconds. Further thrown hits on it deal 15% increased damage.
A thrown hit splashes 35% damage to up to 5 enemies within 2.5 blocks. Can only occur once every second.
Wraithfang flies 25% faster and chains to up to 4 enemies it can see within 10 blocks for 75% damage each, but cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

Wraithfang anchors in its target, pulsing every 0.5 seconds for 25% damage to 6 enemies within 3 blocks. It bursts for 150% after 2 seconds, or when you near it, but cooldown is increased by 2.5 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.op: Spectral Leap lasts 6 seconds instead of 5. With Possession, Wraithfang flies outward that much longer.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.ca: Spectral Leap is 15% faster. With Possession, you blink 15% farther instead.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.pr: The first enemy struck by a throw takes 10% increased Wraithfang melee damage for 4 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.re: Enemies you sweep past during a Spectral Leap or a blink take 35% of Wraithfang's throw damage, up to 8 per throw.
You take no fall damage during a Spectral Leap, and for 2 seconds after it ends.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.th: Catching Wraithfang, or landing a blink, releases 75% of its throw damage to up to 5 enemies within 2.5 blocks.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.co: Kills from Passing Haunt and Arrival Strike refund 0.5 seconds of cooldown, up to 2 seconds per throw.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.fo: Wraithfang follows your aim, turning up to 120 degrees each second while you leap after it, but thrown damage is reduced by 20% and cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.combat.re: Throw without being pulled along. Sneak to blink once to Wraithfang from up to 32 blocks away. Cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.
skill.simplymastery.wraithfang.transform: Haste II from catching Wraithfang lasts 5.5 seconds.
While you have Haste, Wraithfang melee attacks deal 8% increased damage.
Catching Wraithfang grants 3 seconds more Haste.
Alternating throws and melee hits within 3 seconds deals 5% increased damage per swap, up to a maximum of 20%.
A thrown kill grants Haste III for 5 seconds and refunds 1 second of cooldown.
While you have Haste, Wraithfang melee kills refund 0.5 seconds of cooldown, up to 2 seconds for each unbroken Haste.
Your first Wraithfang melee hit within 4 seconds of a catch empowers your next throw by 25% for 5 seconds.

The first catch offers a second throw within 2 seconds for 75% damage, skipping the cooldown. Full cooldown plus 2 seconds begins on its return.
Spectral Downpour cutlasses materialize in 0.5 seconds.
Spectral Downpour radius is increased to 7 blocks.
After the initial hold, cutlasses fall twice as quickly one after another.
Falling cutlasses deal 30% damage to up to 4 other enemies within 2 blocks of impact.
Spectral Downpour summons 28 cutlasses within a 9 block radius for 65% damage. They still leave Gloam, but none embed or can be recovered, and cooldown is increased by 20%.

skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.cad: Bound cutlass recovery radius is increased to 2 blocks.

skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.res: Launched cutlasses travel up to 28 blocks and last up to 5 seconds.

skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.combat.con: Each cutlass already in orbit grants a newly recovered cutlass 4% increased launch damage, up to a maximum of 24%.

skill.simplymastery.wraithmaw.transforma: Gloam left by falling cutlasses has its radius increased to 1.6 blocks.

Gloam begins with Slowness II, lasting 3 seconds.

skill.simplymastery.stormscale.combat.ca: Each arriving attack increases Lightning Rod pulse damage and radius by 1.5% instead of 1%.
skill.simplymastery.stormscale.combat.pr: Lightning Rod pulse growth can reach 100% over a single cast.
skill.simplymastery.stormscale.combat.re: A critical attack sends 2 charges to Lightning Rod, the second at 50% strength. Can only occur once every 0.5 seconds.

skill.simplymastery.stormscale.combat.th: At maximum growth, each arriving attack increases the next pulse by 5%, up to a maximum of 20%.
skill.simplymastery.stormscale.combat.co: Every fifth charge to arrive triggers an extra pulse for 60% damage without adding growth.
skill.simplymastery.stormscale.combat.fo: Every attack triggers an immediate pulse for 55% damage and growth is doubled, but charges no longer travel to Lightning Rod and its pulse radius cannot exceed 4.5 blocks.
skill.simplymastery.stormscale.combat.re: Arriving charges no longer pulse. Store up to 10 and reactivate to release one pulse dealing 35% damage per charge within 6 blocks, but charges expire after 6 seconds and cooldown is increased by 4 seconds.
